title: Full-Site QA and Usability Pass
notes: Fixed normal email and password sign-in so successful authentication always opens the correct Northborn workspace instead of leaving users on the login URL.
Raised readability standards across dashboards, fleet, tickets, timesheets, safety, templates and the public home screen, including previously tiny status and helper text.
Increased mobile touch targets across fleet filters, safety, templates, timesheets and other field controls for easier one-handed use.
Added missing accessible names to fleet-access and pricing controls so icon and edit actions are understandable to assistive technology and automated QA.
Reworked production QA to sign into Manager, Operator and Client accounts directly, test each role independently, and verify safe open-and-cancel interactions for Jobs and Field Tickets.
Separated role-switcher testing from role-route testing so a test helper can no longer hide or falsely report client and operator routing defects.
